_comment: macOS. Replace every /Users/you/... path with your real one. Always call npx by absolute path AND pass env.PATH — MCP clients spawn servers with a stripped environment, and a missing node makes tools silently never appear. ego is NOT an MCP server and is not listed here: it is driven through the ego-browser skill. Cua Driver's path differs per machine: run `cua-driver mcp-config` after installing it and use the exact output it prints.
